name: skill-evaluation-graph
description: Graph-based auditor and behavioral evaluator for Agent Skills across Claude Code, Antigravity, and OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Graph-based evaluation, auditing, and behavioral pressure testing for Agent Skills.
interface.longDescription: SEG is an evidence-driven evaluation graph for Agent Skills. It evaluates token economics, progressive disclosure tiers, multi-harness compatibility, and behavioral resistance to pressure (TDD for prompts). Includes bounded self-healing loops and tamper-evident evaluation receipts.
defaultPrompt: Use skill-evaluation-graph to audit and score the skill in this directory.
Run a behavioral pressure test on this skill to check anti-rationalization defenses.
Profile token budget and progressive disclosure across reference files.
